title: Activity, size and location
summary: UK businesses broken down by location, industry, legal status and employment, and UK enterprise levels measured by turnover.

title: Adoption
summary: Adoption registrations including the age and gender of the children being adopted and whether they were born inside marriage.

title: Ageing
summary: Life expectancy factors and indicators of the health of the elderly in the UK. Statistics to help us understand the needs of an ageing population.

title: Armed forces community
summary: Information about the armed forces community, including those who have previously served in the armed forces (veterans) and their families, to help support the Armed Forces Covenant.

title: Balance of payments
summary: All economic transactions between residents of the UK and the rest of the world.

title: Bankruptcy/insolvency
summary: UK business insolvencies, bankruptcies and other forms of debt relief.

title: Business births, deaths and survival rates
summary: Demography of UK businesses: active businesses, new registrations for VAT and PAYE (births), cessation of trading (deaths), and duration of trading (survival rates).

title: Business innovation
summary: Research and development in the UK carried out or funded by business enterprises, higher education, government (including research councils) and private non-profit organisations.

title: Business services
summary: Size and growth of the UK non-financial business economy as measured by the Annual Business Survey (ABS), and the value of e-commerce and the adoption and use of information and communication technologies (ICTs) by UK businesses.

title: Causes of death
summary: Mortality statistics on deaths registered by age, sex and underlying cause of deaths, including data and analysis on deaths involving the coronavirus (COVID-19).

title: Child health
summary: Children's health and well-being including childhood, infant and perinatal mortality, childhood cancer survival and illness.

title: Conception and fertility rates
summary: Childbearing, conceptions, births and abortions in the UK. Statistics on average family size and maternity trends among women, by age and area.

title: Construction industry
summary: Construction of new buildings and repairs or alterations to existing properties in Great Britain measured by the amount charged for the work, including work by civil engineering companies.

title: Coronavirus (COVID-19)
summary: Latest data and analysis on coronavirus (COVID-19) in the UK and its effect on the economy and society.

title: Crime and justice
summary: Crime levels and trends based primarily on the Crime Survey for England and Wales (CSEW) and police recorded crime data.

title: Deaths
summary: Deaths broken down by age, sex, area and cause of death.

title: Debt
summary: Debt of UK households, broken down by financial debt and property debt.

title: Disability
summary: The lives of disabled people in the UK, including disparities, outcomes for disabled people and impact on day-to-day activities.

title: Divorce
summary: Divorces including same- and opposite-sex marriages, sex and age of people divorcing, children of divorced couples and previous marital status.

title: Drug use, alcohol and smoking
summary: Smoking, drinking and drug taking in Great Britain and associated deaths and illnesses.

title: Earnings and working hours
summary: Average weekly earnings of people in the UK and information on the gender pay gap and low pay. Data from Average Weekly Earnings (AWE) and the Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings (ASHE).

title: Economic inactivity
summary: People not in employment who have not been seeking work within the last 4 weeks and/or are unable to start work within the next 2 weeks.

title: Education and childcare
summary: Early years' childcare, school and college education, higher education and adult learning, including data and analysis on qualifications, personnel, and safety and well-being.

title: Electoral registration
summary: The number of people in the UK and its constituent countries registered to vote in local government and Parliamentary elections.

title: Employment and employee types
summary: Employment rates show the number of people in paid work as a proportion of the population, broken down by age and sex. Includes information on the number of people in employment and vacancies.

title: Environmental accounts
summary: How the environment contributes to the economy, the impact that the economy has on the environment, and how society responds to environmental issues. This page also hosts the development of natural capital accounts.

title: Ethnicity
summary: Ethnicity, national identity and religion in the UK and non-UK born population.

title: Expenditure
summary: Spending patterns of UK households.

title: Families
summary: Number and type of families and households including young adults living with their parents, lone parents, cohabiting couples, multi-generational households and people living alone.

title: Gender identity
summary: Information about people’s gender identity from Census 2021.

title: General elections
summary: Forms of civic engagement, including satisfaction with government and democracy, interest in politics and participation in politics.

title: Gross disposable household income
summary: Gross disposable household income is the amount of money that individuals in the household sector can spend or save after income distribution measures. Figures cover regions, sub-regions and local areas of the UK.

title: Gross Domestic Product (GDP)
summary: Gross domestic product (GDP) estimates are the main measure of UK economic growth based on the value of goods and services produced during a given period. GDP estimates are produced monthly, quarterly and annually as part of the revisions cycle to ensure the timely release of data throughout the year. Our GDP monthly estimate consists of output data and is our most timely official estimate of economic growth. The two publication stages for quarterly estimates are our GDP first quarterly estimate and our quarterly national accounts, which include data on output, expenditure and income.

title: Gross Value Added (GVA)
summary: Estimates of regional gross value added (GVA), which is the value generated by any unit engaged in the production of goods and services. Figures available for local authorities and NUTS regions.

title: Health and life expectancies
summary: Comparisons and inequalities in healthy life expectancies, disability-free life expectancies and life expectancies.

title: Health and well-being
summary: Analyses of social and economic data from government and other organisations to paint a picture of UK society and how it changes, including comparisons with other countries.

title: Health care system
summary: Information about private and public healthcare systems in the UK.

title: Health inequalities
summary: Current patterns and trends in ill health and death by measures of socio-economic status.

title: Home internet and social media usage
summary: Use of the internet and social media broken down by characteristics such as age and sex, including number of people who have used the internet, those who use the internet frequently and those who have never used the internet.

title: Housing
summary: Property price, private rent and household statistics.

title: Income and wealth
summary: UK household income and wealth.

title: Inflation and price indices
summary: The rate of inflation is the change in prices for goods and services over time. Measures of inflation and prices include consumer price inflation, producer price inflation and the House Price Index.

title: International migration
summary: People moving into and out of the UK.

title: International trade
summary: Trade in goods and services across the UK's international borders, including total imports and exports, the types of goods and services traded and general trends in international trade.

title: Investments, pensions and trusts
summary: Net flows of investment into the UK, the number of people who hold pensions of different types, and investments made by various types of trusts.

title: IT and internet industry
summary: Internet sales by businesses in the UK (total value and as a percentage of all retail sales) and the percentage of businesses that have a website and broadband connection. These figures indicate the importance of the internet to UK businesses.

title: Labour productivity
summary: Efficiency of the UK workforce, including output per worker, per job and per hour. Data are available by industry and by region.

title: Language
summary: The proportion of adults using English as their main language and a breakdown of other languages used in the UK and the multilingual population.

title: Leisure and tourism
summary: Tourism to the UK, and UK residents travelling abroad, reasons for travel and money spent. The statistics on UK residents travelling abroad are an informal indicator of living standards.

title: Life expectancies
summary: How long, on average, people can expect to live using estimates of the population and the number of deaths.

title: Live births
summary: Live births by age, sex, marital status, country of birth, socio-economic status, previous children and UK area of parent. Also includes trends in baby names.

title: Local government elections
summary: Individuals’ engagement with local government, including involvement in decision-making.

title: Local government finance
summary: Spending on science, engineering and technology by central government departments, research councils and higher education funding councils (HEFCs).

title: Manufacturing and production industry
summary: UK manufacturing and other production industries (such as mining and quarrying, energy supply, water supply and waste management), including total UK production output, and UK manufactures' sales by product and industrial division, with EU comparisons.

title: Marriage, cohabitation and civil partnerships
summary: Marriages and civil partnerships formed and dissolved, and estimates of the population by marital status and living arrangements.

title: Maternities
summary: Women having babies (including stillbirths). A maternity is a pregnancy resulting in the birth of 1 or more children, therefore, these figures are not the same as the number of babies born.

title: Measuring progress, well-being and beyond GDP
summary: Exploring progress in the UK using statistics on economy, environment and society

title: Mental health
summary: Mental health of children, adolescents and adults.

title: Mergers and acquisitions
summary: Business mergers and acquisitions involving UK companies, including de-mergers and disposals, where the transaction value is £1 million or more.

title: Migration within the UK
summary: Movement of people within the UK, between local authorities and regions in England and Wales and to or from Scotland and Northern Ireland.

title: Out of work benefits
summary: Claimants of unemployment related benefits including Employment and Support Allowance and other incapacity benefits, and Income Support and Pension Credit.

title: Output
summary: Economic output and activity of the UK. Includes manufacturing, production and services, and other measures of economic activity.

title: Pensions, savings and investments
summary: State, private, occupational and workplace pensions, including pension trends that draws together data from other government departments and organisations.

title: Population estimates
summary: Annual population estimates. Figures are available for various administrative and electoral geographies and for different population sub-groups, for example, estimates of the very old and estimates by marital status.

title: Population projections
summary: Projections of the future size and age structure of the population of the UK and its constituent countries. Based on mid-year population estimates and assumptions of future fertility, mortality and migration.

title: Productivity measures
summary: Economic productivity measures (including output per hour, output per job and output per worker), productivity in the public sector, and international comparisons of productivity across the G7 nations.

title: Public sector finance
summary: How the relationship between UK public sector monthly income and expenditure leads to changes in deficit and debt.

title: Public sector personnel
summary: People employed in central and local government, and public corporations, including second jobs in the public sector. Includes Civil Service employment with regional and diversity analyses.

title: Public services productivity
summary: Output, inputs and productivity estimates for public services in the UK, including estimates of healthcare and education productivity.

title: Public spending
summary: UK government debt and deficit as reported each January, April, July and October.

title: Redundancies
summary: People who have been made redundant or have taken voluntary redundancy.

title: Religion
summary: Religious affiliation, including religions among the non-UK born population in England and Wales.

title: Research and development expenditure
summary: Research and development in the UK carried out or funded by business enterprises, higher education, government (including research councils) and private non-profit organisations.

title: Retail industry
summary: Sales by retailers in Great Britain directly to end consumers, including spending on goods (in store and online) (Retail Sales Index) and spending on services (Index of Services). The industry as a whole is used as an indicator of how the wider economy is performing and the strength of consumer spending.

title: Satellite accounts
summary: Accounts that cover activities linked to the economy but not part of the core UK national accounts including environmental accounts, tourism satellite account, and household satellite accounts.

title: Sexual orientation
summary: People's self identified sexual orientation, from Census 2021 data and the Annual Population survey.

title: Social care
summary: People who require social care, as well as those who work in social care, performance levels, and its financial cost.

title: Stillbirths
summary: Stillbirths including cause of death and sex, and analyses by some of the main risk factors affecting stillbirths, including parent age and birthweight.

title: Supply and use tables
summary: Balances showing the relationship between components of value added, industry inputs and outputs, and product supply and demand. A source for the data underlying gross domestic product (GDP).

title: Taxes and revenue
summary: The effect of taxes and benefits on UK household’s income.

title: Tourism industry
summary: Tourism and travel (including accommodation services, food and beverage services, passenger transport services, vehicle hire, travel agencies and sports, recreational and conference services), employment levels and output of the tourism industry, the number of visitors to the UK and the amount they spend.

title: UK sector accounts
summary: Transactions of particular groups of institutions within the UK economy, showing how the income from production is distributed and how savings are used to add wealth through investment in assets.

title: Unemployment
summary: UK unemployment figures. Information on the labour market, young people and workless households.

title: Workplace disputes and working conditions
summary: Work stoppages because of disputes between employers and employees. Includes strikes and lock-outs, number of days lost in the public and private sectors, and number of workers involved.

title: Workplace pensions
summary: Pensions linked to a person's workplace, including defined ambition (DA), defined benefit (DB) and defined contribution (DC) schemes.
